python3 - <<'JOVIAN_SETUP'
import base64, gzip, hashlib, json, os, pathlib, subprocess, tempfile
if os.geteuid() != 0:
    raise SystemExit('Run in the server root terminal.')
payload = ''
data = gzip.decompress(base64.b64decode(payload))
if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() != 'ff153f7d3d0b1011796ea08fabcccf6b3266f72d51fdf47f333069447dad8eee':
    raise SystemExit('Setup checksum mismatch.')
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='jovian-ci-setup-') as folder:
    root = pathlib.Path(folder)
    for name, content in json.loads(data).items():
        target = root / name
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        target.write_text(content)
    subprocess.run(['bash', str(root / 'pms/deploy/ci/setup-server.sh')], check=True)
JOVIAN_SETUP
